summary:
Implemented the rich_measure and VerticalCenter feature without running tests or code, per instructions. Changes: rich/tree.py adds Tree.__rich_measure__ (iterative stack walk, indent 4*level, Measurement import). rich/align.py adds Align.__repr__, a measured-maximum width constraint in Align.__rich_console__ (min with explicit width when given), and a new VerticalCenter class with render, measure, and repr methods using console.size.height and newline-segment padding. rich/console.py sets justify="default" in print's render options. CHANGELOG.md marks 9.8.0 unreleased with an Added subheading (existing entry kept first). tests/test_align.py imports VerticalCenter and adds repr, render (height 6 expects "

foo


"), and measure tests. tests/test_tree.py imports Measurement and adds a measure test expecting (11, 19). Nothing was committed. Unverified: no tests were run, and the render_lines(pad=False) call was checked only by reading its signature.
